info.name: Port Action Runs Authentication / Authorization API

items.docs:
This route allows you to create an access token for your Port account. You can use this token to authenticate your requests to the Port API.

To obtain your client ID and client secret, go to your [Port application](https://app.getport.io), click on the `...` button in the top right corner, then click `Credentials`.
